subject: Charter Review Process and Timeline
overview: The committee met with representatives from the Collins Center for Public Management to outline the legislative steps and deadlines required to implement revisions to the city charter. The session focused on the coordination needed between city and state officials to place a referendum on the November 2025 ballot.

items.title: Charter Review Process and Timeline
items.summary: Kept paper 24468 in committee following a presentation on the legislative sequence and state house deadlines necessary to qualify charter revisions for the 2025 municipal election. Representatives from the Collins Center explained the process of council and mayoral approval, state delegation filing, and the requirement that the state legislature return the special act by September 1 to permit ballot preparation.
